miniProject.title: Actor-critic and PPO with versioned rollouts
miniProject.brief: Build the `policylab` policy laboratory: exact gradient oracles, actor-critic with GAE, and PPO with immutable vector rollouts and full loss tests. Multi-seed CartPole evidence with induced failure postmortems closes the project before language-policy work begins.
steps: Build the exact-enumeration policy-gradient oracle in `deep/` and a REINFORCE update whose expected gradient matches enumeration and finite differences, trained only on fresh trajectories.
Compare full-return, reward-to-go and baseline weightings on shared samples against exact expectations, and ablate the baseline on the short corridor.
Add learned baselines and one-step actor-critic with frozen targets, separate termination from truncation bootstrapping, and prove actor gradients never flow through detached advantages or targets.

Implement GAE by backward recursion with per-lane masks and endpoint oracles for termination, truncation and segment cuts, then test categorical and Gaussian densities with the squashing correction and entropy sign, and ablate trace decay at a matched budget.

Pass Deep-ML 485, add sign-case and gradient regressions for the clipped surrogate, and test value clipping and normalization scope without letting normalized advantages mutate frozen return targets, with a matched normalization ablation.

Collect immutable vector rollouts with behavior-policy identity and per-lane validity masks, verify unit ratios before the first update, and trace ratios with KL across epochs under a declared full-rollout stopping rule, plus a matched update-epoch ablation.
Run multi-seed PPO evidence on CPU with independent checkpoint evaluation on separate streams, and write postmortems for two induced ratio, critic or entropy failures diagnosed from stored rollouts.
deliverables: Policy-gradient and GAE oracles with density, entropy and rollout identity tests.
PPO losses with sign-case, clipping, normalization and stopping regressions.
Multi-seed evidence with raw traces, two failure postmortems and the matched ablations.

checks.name: Deep-ML 485: PPO Clipped Surrogate Loss
checks.note: Pass both public cases; add sign-case and gradient regressions.

rubric.pass: Expected REINFORCE gradients match enumeration, and GAE advantages match their endpoint oracles with per-lane boundaries intact.
rubric.strong: A cross-lane leak is injected and caught by the lane oracle.

rubric.pass: Clipped, value and entropy losses pass sign-case and gradient tests with frozen targets.
rubric.strong: A normalization-scope defect is shown to flip a clipping branch and is pinned by regression.

rubric.pass: Per-epoch ratio and KL traces preserve one denominator under a declared stopping rule.
rubric.strong: Equal clipped objectives with different KL are exhibited on fixed batches.

rubric.pass: Multi-seed evidence uses separate streams with failures retained and no best-seed claim.
rubric.strong: Two induced failures are diagnosed from rollouts before code inspection.

miniProject.feedsInto: Policy oracles, GAE and versioned PPO rollouts feed exploration, offline, model-based and language-policy projects and capstone policy evidence.
